A letter for you 💌

A few words from my heart.

Dear Gungun, meri lotochocopieee 💗🥹 Aaj ka din mere liye sirf aapka birthday nahi hai, balki ek aisa din hai jiske bahane main aapko bata sakta hoon ki aap meri zindagi mein kitni special ho. Sabse pehle toh aapko duniya ki sabse pyaari si birthday wishes. Happy Birthday meri Gungun, meri lotochocopie, meri favourite personnn! 🎂💗🧿 Mujhe aaj bhi woh 21 October 2022 ka din yaad hai, raat ke 8:42 baje, jab maine aapko pehli baar “hlo” message kiya tha. Tab mujhe bilkul nahi pata tha ki ek chhota sa message aage chal kar meri zindagi ki itni pyaari kahaani ka hissa ban jayega. Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon ki agar uss din woh message nahi kiya hota, toh shayad mujhe aap jaisa pyaara insaan milta hi nahi. Ek simple sa “hlo” dheere dheere itni saari baaton, yaadon, hasi, care aur feelings tak pahunch gaya. Aur aaj jab main peeche mud kar dekhta hoon, toh woh chhota sa moment bhi mere liye bahut special lagta hai. 💌 Phir aaya 13 September 2025, woh din jab hum relationship mein aaye. Mere liye woh date bhi hamesha yaad rehne wali dates mein se ek rahegi. Aap meri life ka ek aisa hissa ban gayi ho jiske saath main apni chhoti chhoti khushiyan share karna chahta hoon, apne din ki baatein batana chahta hoon, aur chahta hoon ki aap bhi apni har achhi-buri baat mujhse share kar sako. Main chahta hoon ki aapko hamesha feel ho ki aapki baat sunne wala koi hai, aapki khushi mein khush hone wala koi hai, aur aapke chehre ki smile mere liye important hai. 🥹💕 Haan, hum long distance mein hain. Kabhi kabhi distance sach mein mushkil lagta hoga, kyunki har special moment par saamne hona, aapki smile ko real life mein dekhna, aur aapke saath chhoti chhoti cheezein enjoy karna kitna achha hota. Lekin mere liye distance ka matlab yeh nahi ki aap kam important ho. Aap door ho sakti ho, par meri wishes, care aur feelings aapse door nahi hain. Main chahta hoon ki hum patience, trust, understanding aur honesty ke saath apni kahaani ko aur pyaara banayein. Har din perfect ho zaroori nahi, par har din ek doosre ko samajhne ki koshish zaroor honi chahiye. 💗🫶🏻 Aaj aapke birthday par meri wish hai ki aap hamesha khush raho, dil se smile karo, apne saare dreams poore karo aur zindagi aapko bahut saari achhi cheezein de. Aapko kabhi apni value bhoolne ki zaroorat na pade. Aap jaisi ho, waise hi bahut special ho. Aapki chhoti chhoti khushiyan bhi important hain, aapke goals bhi important hain, aur aapka sukoon bhi. Main chahta hoon ki aap apne liye bhi utna hi pyaar aur time rakho jitna aap doosron ko deti ho. Aapko har woh khushi mile jo aap deserve karti ho, aur jab bhi aap apne birthday ki photos dekho, toh aapko yaad aaye ki aap kitni pyaari aur loved ho. 🌷🎀 Meri lotochocopieee, aap aise hi hasti raho, apni cute si baaton se sabka din achha karti raho, aur apni woh special wali vibe kabhi mat khona. Aapke saath baat karna, aapko chhoti chhoti baatein batana, aur aapke saath future ke cute se plans imagine karna mere liye bahut meaningful hai. Main yeh nahi keh raha ki main hamesha har cheez perfect karunga, par main itna zaroor chahta hoon ki hum ek doosre se khul kar baat karein, ek doosre ki feelings ki respect karein, aur jab kabhi kuch mushkil ho toh use milkar samajhne ki koshish karein. Aapki happiness mere liye important hai, aur main chahta hoon ki aap hamare bond mein safe, respected aur appreciated feel karo. 💞 Kaash aaj main aapko saamne se birthday wish kar pata, aapke saath cake cut kar pata aur aapko yeh saari baatein khud bol pata. Filhaal yeh chhoti si website meri taraf se ek little surprise hai—ismein hamari photos hain, kuch memories hain, aur sabse important, aapke liye mere dil se nikla hua message hai. Photos dekhte hue har moment ko enjoy karna, aur surprise button bhi tap karna, kyunki aapke liye ek aur pyaara sa message chhupa hai. 🎁💗 Thank you meri life mein aane ke liye, uss pehle “hlo” ka reply dene ke liye, aur meri kahaani ka itna special hissa banne ke liye. 21 October 2022 ka woh message aur 13 September 2025 ka woh relationship wala din—dono mere liye alag-alag wajah se special rahenge. Aaj ka din aapka hai, isliye bas aap khush raho, apna birthday enjoy karo, achhe se khaana khao, lots of pictures lo aur jitna ho sake utna smile karo. Aapko bahut saara pyaar, happiness, success, peace aur beautiful memories milen. Once again, HAPPY BIRTHDAYYYYY MERI GUNGUNNNN, MERI LOTOC HOCOPIEEE! 🎂💗🥹🧿 Aap hamesha khush raho, healthy raho, apne dreams ke kareeb jao aur aapki life mein bahut saari khoobsurat cheezein aayein. Aaj ka din aur aane wala poora saal aapke liye bahut pyaara ho. Sending you the biggest virtual birthday wishes and lots of love from my side. 💌🌸
Hamesha aapke liye best wishes ke saath,
Aapka favourite person 💗🫶🏻
